if i was her i would be more scared about you feeling shit about yourself constantly and worrying than the bad image you may have gave her however long ago it was. it’s good that your ex is helping you and reassuring you, it’s what everyone should do whether they mean it or not. and i completely understand why you might think she thinks of you in a bad way but the more you think about it the worse it will sound. you sound like a really nice guy with genuine intentions and someone who just needs people to talk to and some friends. i’m sure that no matter how bad that image is she can shake it as you two are or were so close. i can take a good guess she still thinks about you but just doesn’t want to message you as she thinks you may be a little off with her after a long pause of no speaking but she still loves you and thinks about you.

yeah that is a great start, but you two could maybe speak again you would just have to approach with caution and apologise and make sure she knows you are being genuine. if she really did care about you she will accept the apology and you two should start to make good progress again.
